content: Ishaan Bose followed up with insurance agent Karan Joshi regarding his DCoders health policy. Karan apologized for the auto-renewal issue, explained that the problem was escalated, and informed Ishaan that a new renewal process would be initiated. Karan confirmed that he would send a new signing link to resolve the matter promptly, and Ishaan agreed to wait for it.

action_items: Agent to send new signing link for policy renewal form
Customer to sign and submit the new renewal form
